events.title: Join the free BrickOps playtest on October 3 and 4
events.summary: Bring your squad. Our first free public playtest is coming to Windows on Steam on October 3 and 4. Play. Build. Customize. Get into a match, create your own map and make your character your own. We’re inviting our community, gaming groups, creators and streamers to a weekend of playing, building and feedback. events.title: Introducing BrickOps
events.summary: Hi everyone!We’d like to introduce BrickOps and start sharing more about its development here on Steam.What is BrickOps?BrickOps is an online shooter with block-built arenas. Build your own maps, share them with the community and compete against other players. Alongside Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch and Capture the Flag, we’re planning Defuse and Build & Destroy for release.Build first.
